description: This file defines the PHP class 'Review' within the Opencart\-Catalog\-Controller\-Mail namespace. The class extends the system engine controller and handles email notifications related to product reviews, including composing and sending review-related emails to customers and additional alert emails.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Handles the process of sending review notification emails when a product review is added, including generating email content and managing multiple recipients.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that triggers the email notification process for a product review if mail alerts are enabled, assembling email data, configuring the mail object, and sending emails to the primary recipient and additional alert emails.
